verdict.rationale: Formant documents per-device configuration: export to YAML, save as a template, and APIs to configure devices. Nothing in the evidence shows pushing a configuration change to many robots at once or targeting by group. Device groups and tags appear only for analytics, which is a different feature, and API device configuration is a developer building block rather than bulk fleet config rollout.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can push configuration changes across many robots at once with per-group targeting
